answer: An AI marketplace for comet forecasts, canyon surveys, and garden designs requires every seller identity to lock a bond until its jobs clear a dispute window. Fraud established by arbitration forfeits the bond. New names receive no exemption: operating 1,000 fake sellers requires 1,000 bonds. This does not eliminate sybils, but makes their scale depend on capital the attacker must immobilize and risks losing on fraudulent jobs.
